summary: The video limit now counts each chat on its own: every room may start its own clips each day, instead of all rooms sharing one daily total.
details: The setting is renamed max_clips_per_room_per_day (shipped default 1). A clip the service failed still does not count, and a restart does not reset it.
When a room has used its limit, she says it is this room's limit for today and that it resets tomorrow; other rooms can still start a clip.
limitations: The old setting name max_clips_per_day is refused at startup, with a message naming the new one: a config.toml that sets it must be renamed before this version starts.
The total across all rooms is no longer capped, so the day's spend is now up to the limit times the number of rooms that ask.
